name: Hertz Energy Inc.
summary: Hertz Lithium Inc. is engaged in the acquisition, development, and exploration of mineral properties across the United States, with a primary focus on identifying lithium deposits. A key asset in its portfolio is the Lucky Mica project, located in Maricopa County, Arizona. This project comprises 114 lode mining claims, collectively spanning an area of 938.64 hectares. Established in 2019, the company previously operated as Hybrid Ventures Inc. before officially changing its name to Hertz Lithium Inc. in January 2022. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Vancouver, Canada.
